canonical_baseline_note: The native command compares against the current canonical package in the working tree, so its no-changes recommendation is not a comparison with Git HEAD. Original pre-maintenance digests and verdicts are recorded separately for each result.

focused_examples.method: Execute actual fenced package examples with synthetic process environments and temporary Git fixtures. Cover multiline values, escaped names, invalid PIDs, exact bytes and unavailable Git content.

full_regression.environment_note: An earlier run stalled inside the outer sandbox and was interrupted. The completed run used the same tests outside that restriction. One stale URL expectation was corrected after the first completed regression exposed it.

independent_forward_exercise.independence: A separate agent received only the two packages, repository instructions and the synthetic exercise scope. It did not receive prior reports, expected defects, the implementation tests or their expected answers.
independent_forward_exercise.environment: Disposable local Git and process fixtures; no real host, credentials, service manager operation, network or repository edits.
observations: Different installed bytes produced distinct digests; identical bytes produced matching digests. Successful command exit alone was not treated as equality.
Unavailable reviewed revision/file failed with no digest output; unavailable installed artifact failed after the reviewed digest, leaving comparison inconclusive.
A child with synthetic multiline values and a control character in a variable name emitted only JSON-escaped names; no value fragments were reported.
PIDs 0, -1 and not-a-pid failed with no stdout.
limitations: No real systemd behavior, effective consumed values, access policy, configuration precedence, readiness or rollback was established.
Malformed proc entries and a lack-of-access case were not exercised.
A quoted file path in a fixture does not establish that its basename is a valid real systemd unit name.
independent_forward_exercise.result: No failures found within this bounded synthetic exercise.

maintenance_review.product_direction: Biblioteca geral para agentes e tarefas, incluindo trabalho sem projeto. Finance é um contexto de origem. Preservar mecanismos tecnológicos úteis e separar política de projeto; generalizar a decisão, sem apagar a evidência concreta.

changes.canonical-team-skill-authoring: Clarifica os três níveis de conhecimento, a autonomia de cada pacote e a aplicação condicional do contrato deste catálogo.
changes.clerk-fastapi-trust-boundaries: Remove a dependência operacional de uma skill irmã; mantém o âmbito arquitetural e explicita a evidência mínima para reconhecer um incidente de deployment fora desse âmbito.
changes.credential-source-cutovers: Substitui encaminhamentos obrigatórios por limites e critérios mínimos próprios, preservando as quatro provas de conclusão.
changes.cloudflare-r2-backups-and-bucket-lock: Distingue bytes do payload, sidecars, estrutura e restauro; protege traces; condiciona prune, retenção e instalação à autorização e política existentes.
changes.effective-config-tracing: Corrige a sonda que podia revelar fragmentos de valores multilinha; distingue ambiente inicial de configuração consumida; preserva overrides intencionais e qualifica o exemplo do timer.
changes.mcp-api-capability-triage: Distingue falha anterior ao envio de resultado desconhecido após envio; exige reconciliação ou idempotência documentada antes de repetir escritas.
changes.verify-against-the-host: Corrige a sonda de ambiente e alinha a referência Git com a verificação dos bytes reais e a preservação de falhas.
